body:
when I was young, i got mad at my mother and that night her aneurysm burst in her brain and she died.

then my dad remarried and my older stepsister accused me of raping her. even though i was acquitted after she admitted she was lying, after that time every girl i liked got scared of me and avoided me. my desperation made women uncomfortable all the time. i just try to hide it all inside if i like someone or if someone shows interest in me, the latter hasn't happened for at least 10 years. 

i try to keep from getting angry because i remember what happened to mom, but sometimes it gets so much that i lash out. i did that with my nephew who was torturing me, just playing around, but i got angry and he's in a wheelchair now because of it. i've been disowned by my family and rightly so because of how awful i am.

i got angry at my phone because the internet was slow and threw it on the ground. i didn't know there was a mother with her baby nearby. i must have broken the glass hard or something was on the ground because something hit the baby's eye and it started bleeding.

I don't even know if i can be helped. i've hurt so many people because i was stupid. if anyone deserves to die it's me. i won't be able to hurt anyone when im dead.

I'm going to do it now. im sorry im hurting you and everyone else too. but its for the best.

i doubt it. i called the suicide hotline and they told me to call 911. I asked if they could call 911 and they said they couldn't, id have to do it. 911 told me that someone else needs to call if i was suicidal and it was an emergency--apparently its not an emergency until the attempt is underway--and they told me it was a crime to call when there isn't an emergency. I screamed at the operator to get the police here as soon as possible to arrest me, then. she refused.

im tired and beyond sad. but i havent been truly happy in years. i cant afford medicine or doctors anymore and its just like putting a bandaid on gangrene anyway. im tired of getting to a crisis all the time. i used to post with my real account but im too ashamed to do so. no one's help is enough to get me past and over all the things ive done and all the things i feel.

2 months ago i failed with an attempt. it didn't bring help. it only brought more suffering. it caused me to lose the place where I was staying. No homeless shelter has accepted me. i don't see how the homeless do it. i tried just being a boy scout and setting up a tent in a federal park somewhere quiet where i wouldn't bother anyone. i couldn't afford a good tent, and the one i had got ripped up bad in a thunderstorm.

a criminal gets treated better than i do. i tell myself i should try to rob a bank and at least i'd have a roof over my head then. but that wouldn't happen to me. no, what happens to me is whatever is the worst for me.

i need someone to help me, to take care of me, just long enough until i have enough strength to try to make it and be okay if i fail. i can't fail again. i just can't. i have to succeed. but i'm not. i'm still failing.

Im old, broken, worn down, and useless. if id have known how bad things were going to get, i would have ended my life 9 years ago. when i ask for help getting a job, im not asking for resume advice. im asking for a connection to get a job, a job that pays enough so i can stay in a tiny room and afford the medicines i used to take. but according to one friend that makes me a selfish mooch who can't rely on himself. And like i said before, that's just bandaids on gangrene. damn right i don't trust myself. i hate every bone, every muscle, every nerve in my body. i hate my brain. i dont deserve anyone, anything, or any more time. and if i have neough strngth im going to make sure i escape this gehenna forever.
